title: Hebrew Igrot Kodesh: direct letter body and public search-extract review
review_method: Public web search/open; item-level public Hebrew letter pages and visible search-result body extracts. No runner-side crawler.
source_body_inspection_method: Three public item pages were directly opened with readable Hebrew body text (AID 5054491 existing identity, AID 5100372 new item, and AID 5357409 duplicate manifestation); eight additional public search-result body extracts were inspected. Direct opens of the eight extract-only items redirected to a Torah Texts navigation/summary shell. AID 4666220 was also opened and redirected to a shell; same-run fallback used other accessible Hebrew Igrot Kodesh pages.

fallback_source_results.source: Chabad.org/TheRebbe.org — Hebrew Igrot Kodesh item pages
fallback_source_results.result: Nine new Hebrew correspondence identities were inspected. One direct item body (AID 5100372) remains Verified within the publisher-text scope; eight search-extract-only records remain Parsed. AID 5054491 was reopened and enriched in place. No translation was counted independently.

blocked_candidates.reason: Public web open redirected to https://www.chabad.org/torah-texts/4666220/page/default.htm, a navigation/summary shell with no readable item-level letter body.
blocked_candidates.handling: Excluded from content promotion; no crawler retry or access-control bypass. Nine other Hebrew Igrot Kodesh pages were inspected in the same run as fallback.

not_promoted_after_inspection.reason: The publisher's own note states that this partial presentation was later published more fully as volume 18, letter ג׳קפב, dated 11 Tevet; the full presentation is AID 4872269. The two pages are the same correspondence, not independent witnesses.
not_promoted_after_inspection.handling: Do not create a new Evidence Family or count a second witness. Record a same_evidence_family alias relation to AID 4872269 and audit the canonical identity before applying the family ID.

duplicate_aliases_linked.basis: The AID 5357409 publisher note explicitly cross-references the fuller publication as AID 4872269, volume 18 letter ג׳קפב, dated 11 Tevet 5715. The visible Hebrew body extracts match in circumstances and wording. This is one letter with two publisher presentations, not two independent witnesses.

existing_identity_updates.new_proposition_locator: Chabad.org/TheRebbe.org AID 5054491, body line 298, directly reopened on 2026-11-15.

deduplication_check.note: The review queue and named recent research batches were checked. Connector code search returned no exact-AID matches, but a complete scan of all 461 canonical item files was not available before commit. The reconciliation workflow must confirm stable AID/URL and Evidence Family uniqueness. AID 5357409 is not added as a new item; it is linked to the publisher-identified fuller AID 4872269.

limitations: Eight new identities rely only on visible public search-result body extracts because direct item opens redirected to a summary/navigation shell; they remain Parsed and partial-context.

AID 5100372 is the only new record promoted to Verified because its item-level Hebrew body was directly opened; this verifies only the published text, not an autograph, incoming letter or full archival context.
AID 5054491 is an existing Verified identity reopened and enriched with one additional bounded proposition; its Evidence Family is unchanged.

AID 5071046 is a secretariat cover letter reproducing a telegram explicitly attributed by the publisher to the Rebbe; the cover letter itself is not attributed to the Rebbe and the physical telegram was not inspected.
AID 5357409 is a partial duplicate presentation of AID 4872269; it is not a new source identity or independent witness.
AID 4666220 redirected to a navigation shell and was excluded; the same-run fallback was used.
No original manuscripts, incoming letters, secretariat copies, scans, or full archival contexts were inspected.
No full copyrighted text was copied and no AI-generated inference was attributed to the Rebbe.
note: Batch 092 adds nine new Hebrew Igrot Kodesh Evidence Families, enriches existing AID 5054491 in place, and links the duplicate AID 5357409 presentation to AID 4872269. Metrics remain provisional until deterministic reconciliation and the full readiness gate complete.
